query.description: Include only macroeconomic events that Dow Jones editors have classified as having a market impact. This categorization is based on news judgement and is updated on news merit.
Include only events whose date and time have been confirmed.
Filter events based on time specified

ORed list of countries associated with the event (e.g. BH-Bahrain, AZ-Azerbaijan). These are countries related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the event. Use ISO codes and separate them with new lines when providing multiple codes.

ORed list of countries associated with the event (e.g. BH-Bahrain, AZ-Azerbaijan). These are countries related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the event. Use ISO codes and separate them with new lines when providing multiple codes.

ORed list of regions associated with the event (e.g. EMEM, EU, G10). These are regions related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the event. Use new lines when providing multiple region codes.

ORed list of regions associated with the event (e.g. EMEM, EU, G10). These are regions related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the event. Use new lines when providing multiple region codes.
Event type: ICC-Corporate events, IEP-Economic and Political events, IDC-Treasury Auctions.
Event type: ICC-Corporate events, IEP-Economic and Political events, IDC-Treasury Auctions.

ORed list of event series codes (e.g. TrdBal-Trade Balance, ImptPx-Import Prices). Series codes enable searching for historical and upcoming repeatable events. Use new lines when providing multiple series codes.

ORed list of event series codes (e.g. TrdBal-Trade Balance, ImptPx-Import Prices). Series codes enable searching for historical and upcoming repeatable events. Use new lines when providing multiple series codes.
Single classification of the event (e.g. IEP_STAT-Statistics and Economic Indicators, ICC_ANL-Earnings/Analysts Calls and GMs).

Earliest date and time of interest, yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'.

ORed list of ISINs. Use new lines when providing multiple isin codes.
ORed list of ISINs. Use new lines when providing multiple isin codes.

Include ecoinfo as part of the events results.
